attributes.name: Barnabas Harrigan
attributes.powers:
When you encounter Barnabas Harrigan, succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 14 check or the difficulty of the checks to defeat are increased by 6 and he may not be evaded.

Before you attempt any check to defeat, recharge 1 armor or 1d4 other cards, or discard them if you aren't the only character at that location.

After you act, discard the top 1d4 cards of the blessings deck; if any check to defeat included the Swashbuckling trait, discard the top card of the blessings deck instead.
